artist.name: SODHI
artist.bio: Sodhi is Arjun Sodhi, a bass music DJ from New Delhi who spent his formative years in London. His sets mix grime, bass, hip-hop, afrobeats and dancehall with soundsystem music. He has hosted a monthly show on boxout.fm, toured the UK in 2022 (Corsica Studios in London, Celtronic Festival in Derry) and then played Magnetic Fields.

eras.sound: Grime, bass, hip-hop, afrobeats and dancehall over soundsystem music
